headline: Enciso earns Ipswich a point after Forest dominate chances

sentences.text: Julio Enciso’s 41st-minute equaliser rescued a point for Ipswich at Portman Road after Neco Williams had put Nott'm Forest ahead in the 13th minute.
The 1–1 draw leaves Ipswich 9th on 10 points, but Forest’s 17 shots and 2.29 expected goals to Ipswich’s 7 and 0.46 underline how much pressure the hosts had to withstand.
